label: <DEL> step of maximum-length (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (100% of activation mass on <DEL>), and almost only when the sequence has the maximum length L=9 (90% of mass; about 65% of L=9 delimiter steps fire). There is a weaker tail at L=8 delimiters (13% rate, ~10% of mass), and it never fires for L<=7, during original-token input, or during the copy phase. Within L=9, which tokens it fires on is spread across many weak content effects: more digits among the originals raises the rate (lift goes from 0.7x with 0 digits to 3x+ with 4 or more), and first tokens 1/o/z/0 help slightly. No single token rule picks out the 35% of L=9 delimiters where it is silent. Magnitude is small (max 0.016) and is highest for L=9.
